classes.name: project
classes.description: Project container scoping missions, milestones, and admitted project facts within an organizational scope.

classes.name: milestoneProgress
classes.description: Track-aligned milestone, workpackage, or stream realization state with structured RACI C1 fields.

classes.name: spec
classes.description: Versioned specification document governed under D2 mandatory review and content digest pinning.

classes.name: mission
classes.description: Focus anchor linking a session work stream to a project, a Track item, a milestone, and a target spec.

classes.name: decisionDossier
classes.description: Contextualized D27 decision dossier presenting options, trade-offs, and cited evidence facts.

classes.name: decision
classes.description: Project or harness normative decision carrying RACI C1/C2/C3 attribution and reversibility class.

classes.name: request
classes.description: Explicit owner directive, spec amendment request, clarification, or spawn request traced to resolution.

classes.name: fact
classes.description: Admitted or candidate memory note (context, decision, or evidence) with citations and temporal validity.

classes.name: fact_proposal
classes.description: Extraction or promotion draft gated by D1 bounded-type control, D5 same-agent visibility, and third-party review.

classes.name: session
classes.description: Duration-less session anchor binding CLI or app-chat incarnation epochs, tenant/workspace scope, and continuous Git read context.

classes.name: lectureGit
classes.description: Read side of continuous Git indexing exposing line attribution, rename lineage, symbol evolution, revision diffs, and pinned search.

classes.name: contextQuery
classes.description: Per-turn declarative graph query AST (engram_memory_context) seeded by host-verified mandate and previous-step pointers.

classes.name: contextAnswerPack
classes.description: Five-slice next-turn context pack (AnswerPackV2) with D6 refs/content mode, storage placement, and store watermark.

classes.name: owner_turn
classes.description: First-rank raw owner speech turn captured with pseudonymized actor attribution and D12 sweep state.

classes.name: agent_turn
classes.description: Agent speech turn recording model identity, token usage, summary, and consumed context pack digest.

classes.name: tool_call
classes.description: Tool invocation event recording MCP provider, argument digest, hook point, and working directory.

classes.name: tool_result
classes.description: Tool execution outcome paired with a tool_call, carrying exit status, artifact digests, and bounded summary.

classes.name: owner_decision
classes.description: Explicit D27 owner review verdict (raw/earned) or D12 sweep-derived decision signal (derived/asserted).

classes.name: rule_trigger
classes.description: System control rule evaluation event recording enforcement mode, borne-review verdict, and reason code.

classes.name: mandate_change
classes.description: Formal h2a mandate issuance, renewal, claim, or revocation event grounded on authority-native records.

classes.name: role_proposal
classes.description: Derived D16 proactive role assignment proposal emitted when a session operates without an assigned role.

classes.name: promotion_sweep
classes.description: Post-turn D12 or dream-cycle D25 extraction sweep turning raw turn/tool signals into candidate proposals.

classes.name: gh_input_event
classes.description: Normalized D30 external GitHub PR, review, issue comment, or project board event ingested into engram first.

classes.name: project_event
classes.description: Live project tracking event (PR merge, owner answer/request, or milestone transition) recorded in engram.

classes.name: dream_synthesis
classes.description: Dormant D25 dreaming consolidation event synthesizing recurring patterns and contradicted facts for owner review.

classes.name: actor
classes.description: Governed archi@1 non-container card kind representing a human, agent, team, or organization.

classes.name: system
classes.description: Governed archi@1 foldable container kind representing a C4 software system or subsystem.

classes.name: repo
classes.description: Governed archi@1 foldable source-control repository container (archi-source tree root).

classes.name: package
classes.description: Governed archi@1 foldable package container (library, plugin, or app) and required parent root for components.

classes.name: component
classes.description: Governed archi@1 internal code component card requiring a parent package in archi-composition.

classes.name: runtime
classes.description: Governed archi@1 executable runtime card (cli, mcp-server, daemon, job, or hook).

classes.name: service
classes.description: Governed archi@1 network or MCP service card deployed on a host and operated by an actor or system.

classes.name: api
classes.description: Governed archi@1 API contract card (mcp, http, or cli) declaring read-only or read-write access.

classes.name: store
classes.description: Governed archi@1 persistence store card (jsonl, file, database, object-store, or graph) with explicit writer policy.

classes.name: artifact
classes.description: Governed archi@1 declarative artifact card (skill, manifest, schema, or doc) loaded by runtimes or documenting elements.

classes.name: host
classes.description: Governed archi@1 foldable execution host container (workstation, cluster, or cloud-project).

classes.name: orgScope
classes.description: Organizational or workpackage scope (org:h2a, org:h2a/wp1..wp14, org:h2a/security) partitioning roles, RACI, and repo policies.

classes.name: role
classes.description: Governance role class in the h2a signing authority matrix (PRINCIPAL, EXECUTIF, CONDUCTOR, CONTROL, AGENTS, MANDATAIRE).

fields.name: orgScopeId
fields.source: h2a-confirmed: org.h2a.yaml (role = org-wide kind; scope binding on roleInstance)

classes.name: roleInstance
classes.description: Durable named actor instance (13 instances in org.h2a.yaml across human-classic and h2a-standard actor classes).

classes.name: activityType
classes.description: Typical D16 role activity node modelled in engram under the h2a role ontology for proactive role consciousness.

classes.name: raciAssignment
classes.description: Structured RACI responsibility assignment enforcing C1 (single accountable, non-empty responsible) and C2 architect counterweight.

classes.name: authorityRecord
classes.description: Nine-arm native governance authority record evaluated fail-closed under DEP-AUTH-B/M0, B5+, and SG-R15.

classes.name: mandate
classes.description: Signed session mandate envelope issued by PRINCIPAL or EXECUTIF, primary D22 seed and D1/D6/D10 authorization carrier.

classes.name: harnessSkill
classes.description: Master harness or built-in h2a/Track/Focus skill node modeled as a directed phase graph, reviewed at the threshold of a multi-repo dreaming audit.

classes.name: roleWorkflowGraph
classes.description: Directed workflow graph binding an h2a role to its entry skill, allowed skill set, and proactive invocation triggers.

classes.name: skillPhase
classes.description: Ordered phase node inside a harnessSkill DAG declaring instructions and required output artifacts.

classes.name: skillGate
classes.description: Verification or review gate guarding a harnessSkill phase, subject to cyber + arch independent review legs on gate changes.

classes.name: skillToolBinding
classes.description: Declarative binding between a harnessSkill and an MCP tool route with read/write access mode and emitted artifact kind.

classes.name: workspaceHarnessOverlay
classes.description: Repository-local single-base G0 derivation overlay serialized in <repo>/.h2a/overlay.json that evolves solely for and inside its repository without weakening core gates (D31, D34).
